purpose: Preserve deterministic actor-directional and dyadic Western geometry before later outcome calibration without assigning new meanings, weights, thresholds, probabilities, or hit/miss labels.
composite_midpoint_tie_rule: For an exact 180-degree natal-body separation, choose the lower of the two antipodal midpoint longitudes so the atomic composite remains invariant under actor swapping.

fixed_key_rules.directional_synastry: For each actor a and b, emit the Cartesian product of bodies as actor_BODY__partner_BODY.
fixed_key_rules.house_overlays: For each actor, partner body, and declared target house, emit partner_BODY__actor_house_N.
fixed_key_rules.composite_aspects: Emit each unordered pair of composite_bodies exactly once as BODY_A__BODY_B in schema order.

scientific_boundary: The complete geometry is frozen so later feature selection can be audited; it does not authorize unrestricted post-outcome selection.
Legacy AstroRRF V0.1 weighted scores remain unchanged and separately identifiable.
No V0.2 through V0.4 narrative or unweighted family is converted into a numeric rule by this schema.
A later ordinal model must be trained only on a preassigned development cohort and evaluated on a person-exclusive cohort not used to choose features, weights, thresholds, or outcome bindings.
These atomic values are not calibrated relationship outcomes or probabilities.
